title.en: Who is Ben Carroll, the man who wants to be Victoria’s next premier?
title.zh: 本·卡罗尔是谁？这位想成为维多利亚州下一任州长的人

summary.en: Ben Carroll has confirmed his intention to challenge for the leadership of the Victorian Labor party, describing himself as ambitious and a “marathon runner.” This marks his second attempt after an unsuccessful bid in 2023.
summary.zh: 本·卡罗尔已确认他将挑战维多利亚州工党领袖职位，他形容自己雄心勃勃，是一名“马拉松选手”。这是他继2023年首次尝试失败后的第二次努力。

body.en: Carroll, who has confirmed he will make a leadership challenge, says he is a ‘marathon runner’ who has always been ambitious In 2023, when then-public transport minister Ben Carroll failed in his surprising bid to secure the leadership of the Victorian Labor party, he told a press conference: “I was always very keen to rise.” The premier Daniel Andrews had resigned believing he had locked in his succession plan: his loyal deputy Jacinta Allan as premier, and treasurer Tim Pallas as deputy. Continue reading...
body.zh: 卡罗尔已确认将挑战领导地位，并表示自己是一位一直雄心勃勃的“马拉松运动员”。2023年，当时任公共交通部长本·卡罗尔未能确保维多利亚工党的领导地位时，他在新闻发布会上表示：“我一直非常渴望崛起。”州长丹尼尔·安德鲁斯(Daniel Andrews)辞职，相信自己已经锁定了自己的继任计划：忠诚的副手杰辛塔·艾伦(Jacinta Allan)担任总理，财务主管蒂姆·帕拉斯(Tim Pallas)担任副手。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of political leadership often involves great ambition and sustained effort, as seen in Ben Carroll's "marathon runner" approach to a leadership challenge. Yet, this verse reminds us that while individuals strive for positions of influence, Yahweh ultimately determines who rises and who falls. It encourages a perspective where human endeavors are...
reflection.zh: 追求政治领导职位常需要巨大的抱负和持续的努力，正如本·卡罗尔以“马拉松选手”的姿态迎接领导权挑战。然而，这节经文提醒我们，尽管个人为影响力而奋斗，但最终谁能上位、谁会落选，都由雅伟决定。它鼓励我们将人类的努力置于神圣主权的背景下看待。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Australia news live: gasps in NSW State Library as AusAlert blares; some users report not receiving emergency warning test
title.zh: 雅辛塔·艾伦在州工党派系会议后失去多数党团支持

summary.en: Jacinta Allan, the Premier of Victoria, has reportedly lost majority support within her state Labor caucus following a factional meeting. Separately, a key figure in an anti-corruption inquiry involving the New South Wales Liberal party has moved to the UK and will not appear.
summary.zh: 维多利亚州州长雅辛塔·艾伦在州工党派系会议后，据报失去了党团多数支持。此外，一名涉及新南威尔士州自由党反腐调查的关键人物已移居英国，将不会出庭。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast What you need to know about today’s AusAlert test It’s also well worth watching this video of Guardian Australia’s community affairs reporter Adeshola Ore ’s interview with Barnaby Joyce about Armidale’s refugee resettlement program and One Nation’s policy positions on immigration. One Nation’s policy is that immigrants who do not speak English should “under no circumstances … be able to settle in Australia”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一夜之间，人们猜测维州工党总理杰辛塔·艾伦将在本周面临领导层挑战，此时距选举仅四个月。 工党左翼和右翼的派系召集人周日晚上开会，讨论艾伦是否仍获得党团多数成员的支持。据了解，该组织一致认为她没有这样做。 但挑战领导地位的途径仍不清楚，因为艾伦最有可能的对手——副总理本·卡罗尔——已向同事们表示，只有在该职位空缺的情况下，他才会参选。

reflection.en: Political leadership, like any position of authority, is ideally established on principles of integrity and justice. When leaders face challenges to their support or inquiries into their conduct, it underscores the importance of righteousness in maintaining a stable and trusted government. Yahweh reminds us that good governance is founded on ethical...
reflection.zh: 政治领导，如同任何权威职位，理想上应建立在正直和公义的原则之上。当领导者面临支持挑战或行为调查时，这突显了公义对于维持稳定和受信任政府的重要性。雅伟提醒我们，良好的治理是建立在道德行为而非仅仅权力之上。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Seven suspected new bird flu cases are ‘evidence of spread’ into Australian wildlife, experts warn
title.zh: 专家警告：七例疑似禽流感新病例是“蔓延”至澳大利亚野生动物的“证据”

summary.en: BirdLife Australia has reported that seven suspected new cases of bird flu among sick and dead seabirds in South Australia indicate the outbreak is spreading into the local wildlife population.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚鸟类协会报告称，南澳大利亚发现七例疑似禽流感新病例，当地海鸟出现病死情况，表明疫情正在向当地野生动物蔓延。

body.en: BirdLife Australia says discoveries of sick and dead local seabirds in South Australia show outbreak is ‘taking hold’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast South Australia has reported seven new suspected cases of deadly H5 bird flu , with experts warning it could be a sign the disease has begun spreading through local bird populations. All seven birds are greater crested terns – a common local seabird – and were found on the Limestone Coast in south-eastern SA, with one found at Cape Jaffa, five around Southend Jetty near Beachport and one at Port MacDonald, just over 20km from the Victorian border. Continue reading...
body.zh: 澳大利亚鸟类保护协会表示，南澳大利亚州发现的患病和死亡的当地海鸟表明疫情正在“蔓延” 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 南澳大利亚州报告了 7 起新的致命 H5 禽流感疑似病例，专家警告称，这可能表明该疾病已开始在当地鸟类种群中传播。这七只鸟都是大凤头燕鸥——一种常见的当地海鸟——是在南澳州东南部的石灰岩海岸发现的，其中一只在雅法角发现，五只在海滩港附近的绍森德码头附近发现，一只在距离维多利亚边境仅 20 多公里的麦克唐纳港发现。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of bird flu spreading among Australian seabirds reminds us of the fragility of life and the interconnectedness of all creation. Yahweh's creation, in its beauty and vulnerability, often experiences suffering and distress. This calls us to a deeper awareness of the world around us and the shared experience of all living things.
reflection.zh: 禽流感在澳大利亚海鸟中蔓延的消息，提醒我们生命的脆弱和万物互联。雅伟的创造，在其美丽与脆弱中，常常经历苦难和困境。这呼唤我们更深入地认识周围的世界，以及所有生物共同的经历。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

Kumanjayi White, 24, died in the Coles supermarket in the Northern Territory city on 27 May, 2025 after two plainclothes police officers held him down in the confectionary aisle, sparking national outrage and rallies calling for an independent investigation. reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Palestine Action activists face being sentenced as terrorists over bank damage
title.zh: 巴勒斯坦行动组织活动人士因破坏银行面临恐怖分子量刑

summary.en: Five activists from Palestine Action have been convicted for damaging a Barclays Bank branch in Burnley. A judge is considering whether to classify their actions, which involved breaking windows and throwing red paint, as having a “terrorist connection” during sentencing.
summary.zh: 巴勒斯坦行动组织的五名活动人士因破坏伯恩利的一家巴克莱银行分行而被定罪。一名法官正在考虑在量刑时，是否将他们打破窗户和泼洒红漆的行为认定为具有“恐怖主义关联”。

body.en: Exclusive: Judge intends to consider ‘terrorist connection’ after convicting five for damage to Barclays in Burnley Five Palestine Action activists face being sentenced as terrorists for breaking windows and throwing red paint at a branch of Barclays Bank in Lancashire. Brendon O’Hagan, 28; Amanda Kelly, 31; Humeera Atiqnisar, 31; Mohammed Malik, 28; and Alma Yaniv, 70, were found guilty of causing £212,000 of damage during a direct action protest in Burnley in August 2024. They targeted the bank because it held shares in the Israeli weapons firm Elbit Systems. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：法官在伯恩利对五名巴克莱银行造成损害的罪名被定罪后，打算考虑“与恐怖分子有联系”。五名巴勒斯坦行动活动人士因打破窗户并向兰开夏郡巴克莱银行分行投掷红色油漆而面临恐怖分子判刑。布伦登·奥哈根，28；阿曼达·凯利，31；胡梅拉·阿提克尼萨尔，31；穆罕默德·马利克，28； 70 岁的阿尔玛·亚尼夫 (Alma Yaniv) 被判在 2024 年 8 月伯恩利的直接行动抗议中造成 212,000 英镑的损失。他们瞄准该银行是因为该银行持有以色列武器公司埃尔比特系统公司 (Elbit Systems) 的股份。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the complex challenge of responding to perceived injustice, and the severe consequences that can follow certain forms of protest. Yahweh's word reminds us not to be overcome by evil, but to overcome evil with good, urging us to seek responses that break cycles of escalation rather than perpetuating them. This principle applies to both...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了回应感知到的不公的复杂挑战，以及某些形式的抗议可能带来的严重后果。雅伟的话语提醒我们不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶，敦促我们寻求打破升级循环而非使其延续的回应方式。这一原则既适用于抗议者，也适用于司法管理者，鼓励走向和解和建设性解决的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Macron calls crisis meeting as wildfires threaten Bordeaux and heatwave looms
title.zh: 野火威胁波尔多，热浪迫在眉睫，马克龙召开危机会议

summary.en: Blazes are about 15km from Bordeaux, but the city's mayor says there are no plans to evacuate.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
French President Emmanuel Macron will a hold a crisis cabinet meeting on Monday as wildfires close in on the south-western city of Bordeaux.

Another heatwave is set to complicate efforts to tackle the expanding blaze, which is about 15km (9 miles) from Bordeaux, mayor Thomas Cazenave said. Earlier he said there were no plans to evacuate the population of about 850,000.

Wildfires have raged across Europe over the past week, primarily in France and Spain, where more than 330,000 people have been evacuated across both countries.

Macron said on Saturday that France would "rebuild" and his government would "be there for as long as is needed".

Tens of thousands of people have already been evacuated from Bordeaux's surrounding region, with France's Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez saying the situation remained "very unfavourable" and the fire was "moving erratically" towards the city.

Weather forecasts for the country warned that temperatures could spike to 40C in some areas from Tuesday.

France's main fire in the Gironde region has caused an unprecedented "pyrocumulonimbus" - a giant fire thunderstorm fuelled by its own winds and lightning, said the National Firefighters Federation of France (FNSPF).

"We don't know how the blaze will spread, the fire front is constantly shifting. We cannot fight it directly," said spokesman Eric Brocardi.

He added that to control the blaze, it would need to rain "heavily for three days" or require firefighters steering it towards a place where it can die down on its own, like the sea.

The wildfires have badly affected France. About 42,000 hectares have been burnt in the south-west, in one of the largest forest fires since World War Two. Since the start of the year, about 98,000 hectares have been scorched.

Meanwhile, firefighters in Spain battled a new blaze on Sunday near the eastern coastal city of Valencia where around 15,000 people have been forced to flee their homes.

Pilar Bernabe, the central government's delegate to Valencia, said the fire had been "very intense" and weather conditions were expected to worsen.

Spain's Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska, who is expected to visit affected areas in Valencia on Monday, said the fires were advancing slowly.

"Difficult hours lie ahead," said Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez during a visit to the fire zone in Ávila province, west of Madrid.

Spain's King Felipe VI said the wildfires had caused "incalculable" damage to the country's natural heritage, as he toured an emergency shelter in Villamanta, south-west of the capital.

Around 77,000 hectares have been affected by the fires in Spain, minister for ecological transition, Sara Aagesen, said on Sunday.

She added that the wildfire burning in the Ávila region is the largest in the country's recent...
body.zh: 随着野火逼近西南部城市波尔多，法国总统马克龙将于周一召开危机内阁会议。 市长托马斯·卡泽纳夫表示，另一场热浪将使扑灭不断扩大的大火的努力变得更加复杂，大火距离波尔多约 15 公里（9 英里）。早些时候他表示，没有计划疏散约 85 万人口。 过去一周，野火在欧洲肆虐，主要是在法国和西班牙，两国已有超过 33 万人被疏散。 马克龙周六表示，法国将“重建”，他的政府将“只要需要就一直存在”。 波尔多周边地区已有数万人被疏散，法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，局势仍然“非常不利”，火势“不稳定地”向该市蔓延。 该国天气预报警告称，从周二开始，部分地区气温可能飙升至 40 摄氏度。 法国国家消防员联合会（FNSPF）表示，法国吉伦特省的主要火灾引发了前所未有的“火积雨云”，这是一场由自身风和闪电助长的巨大火灾雷暴。 发言人埃里克·布罗卡迪（Eric Brocardi）表示：“我们不知道火势将如何蔓延，火锋不断变化。我们无法直接扑灭。” 他补充说，为了控制火势，需要“持续三天的大雨”，或者需要消防员将火引导到可以自行熄灭的地方，比如大海。 野火对法国造成了严重影响。西南部约 42,000 公顷土地被烧毁，这是第二次世界大战以来最大的森林火灾之一。自今年年初以来，已有约 98,000 公顷土地被烧焦。 与此同时，周日，西班牙消防队员在东部沿海城市巴伦西亚附近扑灭了一场新的火灾，那里约有 15,000 人被迫逃离家园。 中央政府驻巴伦西亚代表皮拉尔·伯纳贝表示，火灾“非常猛烈”，预计天气状况将会恶化。 西班牙内政部长费尔南多·格兰德·马拉斯卡预计将于周一访问巴伦西亚受影响地区，他表示火灾进展缓慢。 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯在视察马德里西部阿维拉省的火区时表示：“困难的时刻即将到来。” 西班牙国王费利佩六世在参观位于首都西南部维拉曼塔的紧急避难所时表示，野火对该国的自然遗产造成了“无法估量”的破坏。 西班牙生态转型部长萨拉·奥格森 (Sara Aagesen) 周日表示，西班牙约 77,000 公顷土地受到火灾影响。 她补充说，阿维拉地区燃烧的野火是该国最近...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Watch: Scaffolding ripped from Hong Kong building as Typhoon Noul makes landfall
title.zh: 观看：台风“诺尔”登陆香港，脚手架被从建筑物上撕裂

summary.en: Typhoon Noul, identified by state media as the strongest to hit China this year, caused significant damage in Hong Kong, including scaffolding being torn from a building.
summary.zh: 据官方媒体报道，台风“诺尔”是今年迄今为止登陆中国的最强台风，在香港造成了严重破坏，包括有建筑物的脚手架被撕裂。

body.en:
Police said they received numerous calls after multi-storey scaffolding along Cheung Sha Wan Road collapsed in powerful winds on Saturday. No injuries have been reported.

Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China on Sunday morning, lashing the region with strong winds and heavy rain and forcing Hong Kong airport to cancel around 360 passenger flights.

The typhoon is the strongest to make landfall in China in 2026 to date, according to state media.
body.zh: 警方表示，周六长沙湾道多层脚手架在强风中倒塌后，他们接到大量报警电话。目前还没有人员受伤的报道。 台风诺尔周日早上在中国南部登陆，给该地区带来强风和大雨，迫使香港机场取消约360个客运航班。 据官方媒体报道，这场台风是迄今为止在 2026 年登陆中国的最强台风。

reflection.en: In the face of powerful natural forces like Typhoon Noul, human structures can seem fragile and vulnerable. Yet, even amidst the chaos and destruction, we are reminded that Yahweh remains our steadfast refuge and strength. He is an ever-present help for those facing trouble and uncertainty.
reflection.zh: 面对像台风“诺尔”这样强大的自然力量，人类的建筑显得脆弱不堪。然而，即使在混乱和破坏之中，我们也当铭记雅伟是我们坚固的避难所和力量。祂是那些面临困境和不确定性之人的随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Argentinian leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
title.zh: 阿根廷领导人称巴西总统是“小偷”和“罪犯”

summary.en: Javier Milei made the comments while in Brazil at a rally to launch the campaign of right-wing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Brazil has recalled its ambassador to Buenos Aires after Argentina's president hit out at the Brazilian president, referring to him as a "thief" and a "convict".

Javier Milei made the comments on Sunday at a rally in Sao Paulo to launch the presidential campaign of right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who is set to run in an election in October.

Without naming Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva explicitly, he referred to the Brazilian president derogatorily while speaking alongside Bolsonaro, who he went on to say was the only one who could "stop Lula".

Brazilian diplomats later said the Argentine leader had insulted Brazil's government, its people, and its democracy.

Speaking later on Sunday, Lula said he would continue to lead "without anyone's interference," and that "in Brazil, we do not accept anyone sticking their nose where it doesn't belong".

Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, was due to return home between Sunday and Monday, AFP reported.

Flavio Bolsanaro is the son of Brazil's former president, Jair Bolsonaro, who was l ast year sentenced to more than 27 years in jail for plotting a coup aimed at keeping him in power after he lost the last election to Lula.

The judge who oversaw the conviction of Jair Bolsonaro, Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, was also referred to by Milei as "bald trash".

Moraes had also previously denied Milei permission to visit the former president while he was under house arrest in Brasilia.

In 2018, Lula was sentenced to 12 years in prison over a massive corruption and bribery scandal , but was released after serving a little over 18 months.

Lula's convictions were annulled by the Supreme Court in 2021 and in presidential elections the following year he narrowly beat far-right incumbent Jair Bolsonaro , winning 50.9% of the vote.

title.en: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
title.zh: 内塔尼亚胡指责纽约市市长马姆达尼在逮捕威胁后“煽动仇恨”

summary.en: Mamdani walked back his threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he planned to attend the UN General Assembly in New York City this autumn, despite the city's mayor, Zohran Mamdani, making threats to arrest him.

Mamdani walked back that threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court, the world's top war-crimes court.

The Israeli leader told Fox News on Sunday that he was "not concerned" about Mamdani's previous pledge and accused the mayor of "fomenting hate".

"He's supposed to be the mayor of all New Yorkers, Jews, Christians, Muslims, everyone, but he's trying to turn one group against the other," Netanyahu said.

Netanyahu referenced a pair of stabbings in New York on Thursday, in which a suspect stabbed a Jewish man and an Asian man just blocks apart.

The suspect allegedly shouted the phrase "Allahu akbar" while committing the stabbings, according to police. He has been charged with hate crimes relating to each victim.

Both men survived the attacks, which drew condemnations from the city's Jewish and Asian American leaders.

Mamdani, a staunch supporter of Palestinian rights, made his opposition to the Israeli military operation in Gaza a central plank of his campaign last year. In an address last week, he called Netanyahu a "war criminal."

As part of that platform while campaigning, Mamdani promised to enforce a 2024 arrest warrant for Netanyahu from the International Criminal Court (ICC), which accused the prime minister of committing war crimes in Gaza.

Israel has denied charges that it has committed war crimes in Gaza, and Netanyahu called the charges "bogus".

The Israeli military entered Gaza after the Hamas-led attack in Israel on 7 October 2023. About 1,200 people were killed and 251 were taken hostage.

Over 73,000 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza since then, including more than 21,000 children, according to the territory's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN.

Last week, after the New York Times pressed Mamdani on his pledge to arrest Netanyahu, Mamdani said his administration had reviewed the law and found: "We do not have the independent legal authority to enforce this warrant".

Mamdani urged the federal government to arrest the prime minister, and said: "Benjamin Netanyahu is not welcome in New York City."

body.en:
The reigning 57kg world champion boxer Jaismine Lamboria from India throws punches for a living, but when it comes to handling pressure, she looks to one of her country's most celebrated cricketing legends for inspiration.

"I really admire MS Dhoni's mindset," says the soft-spoken Lamboria of the former Indian captain. "He is known as 'Captain Cool' for a reason, and I want to be calm like him."

The 24-year-old is one of India's strongest boxing gold-medal prospects at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games , looking to improve on the bronze she won at Birmingham 2022.

Coming off a breakout 2025 during which she won World Cup golds in Astana and Delhi before becoming world champion in Liverpool, Lamboria is in Glasgow with an uncomplicated ambition.

"I aim to change the colour of that medal to gold," she says. "That's what I've been training and preparing towards."

At 5ft 8½in, Lamboria is tall by Indian boxing standards. Her Olympic debut in Paris ended in a first-round defeat to Tokyo silver medallist Nesthy Petecio of the Philippines.

But the setback came in the weight class she had only recently returned to. After spending nearly three years boxing at 60kg, Lamboria dropped back to 57kg during the Paris qualification campaign - a move that ultimately paid off when she won the world title by defeating Paris Olympic silver medallist Julia Atena Szeremeta of Poland.

"That Paris 2024 Olympics exit was disappointing but it was an eye-opener," says Lamboria. "It prompted several changes in me - physically and mentally. And a significant part of it has come about at the Army Sports Institute (ASI) in Pune, which is where I train."

Lamboria credits her ASI coaches for improving his physical strength and a motivational coach and sports psychologist for sharpening her mental game.

The Indian Army, however, has provided the wider institutional framework around much of her development.

After winning bronze at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, Lamboria became the first female boxer inducted into the army, joining the Corps of Military Police. She now trains under its Mission Olympics Wing.

"It's a great honour they wanted to begin with me, but I also see it as an opportunity to become a role model for female athletes," says Lamboria of joining a system that has produced Olympians and Paralympians, including Olympic javelin champion Neeraj Chopra.

In early 2024, the Indian Army launched the Girls Sports Company to train girls aged 12 to 16 in four Olympic sports, including boxing, creating a pathway to elite competition and army recruitment.

title.en: Israeli settlers torch two mosques in West Bank during a deadly surge in violence

summary.en: Violence in the Israeli-occupied West Bank has surged since the Gaza war began.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Two mosques in the Israeli-occupied West Bank were set on fire overnight in an apparent Israeli settler attack, officials said overnight, after a spate of deadly violence that killed four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers.

Palestinians and the Israeli opposition accuse Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's hard-line government of turning a blind eye to attacks by settlers against Palestinians , which threaten to ignite widespread violence across the territory.

Israeli soldiers and police fanned out across the West Bank after the attack, closing off major roads and blocking access to a hospital. Israel also arrested more than 70 Palestinians over the weekend.

The mosques, in the villages of Qusra and Kour in the northern West Bank, suffered extensive damage in the fires.

In Qusra, the attackers spray-painted "revenge Benayahu," referring to one of the settlers killed on Friday, and "the land of Israel is redeemed with blood".

Ahmed Abu Mahmoud, 64, who lives next to the Qusra mosque, said he heard noises at 3am and discovered the mosque had been set on fire. The fire was too large for him to fight on his own, so he called for help.

"The military arrived here, saw with their own eyes and then left," Mahmoud said.

He added that the attackers spray-painted Hebrew graffiti on the mosque's walls, including the word "revenge".

Security footage in Kour obtained by The Associated Press showed three people dressed in civilian clothes setting off a large explosion in the entrance of the mosque in the middle of the night.

In a separate incident, Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in the village of Kour, near Tulkarem, and spray-painted racist slogans on its walls, according to the Palestinian ministry of religious affairs.

The ministry said that "groups of settlers burned a mosque in the village of Kour in Tulkarem governorate and wrote racist slogans on its walls".

Israel's military said it was working with police to investigate the mosque attack.

"The security forces strongly condemn incidents of this kind, including harm to religious sites, and will continue to act decisively to maintain security and public order in the area," it said.

The Israeli army often announces investigations into violence against Palestinians but rarely makes arrests or prosecutes settlers involved in violence.

The exact circumstances of Friday's deadly incidents remained unclear, but Israeli media reports and interviews with local Palestinian officials said they were sparked after a group of armed settlers entered the village of Tell and were resisted by residents who were fearful of an attack.

title.zh: 美国和伊朗暂停轰炸，为谈判创造空间

summary.en: A temporary halt in fighting between the US and Iran has occurred for a second night, as both nations face rising military costs and ongoing regional tensions.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗连续第二晚暂停轰炸，两国均面临军事成本上升和地区紧张局势持续的局面，此举为谈判创造了空间。

body.en:
The United States has paused its bombing campaign against Iran for a second consecutive night, with both the US and Iran signalling a willingness to give diplomacy another chance after nearly two weeks of escalating military action.

The pause follows reports senior US military officials advised US President Donald Trump the bombing campaign had reached the limits of its effectiveness, while warning US stocks of key munitions were being depleted.

US ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz told Fox News that Trump had suspended strikes to create space for negotiations, while an Iranian official told the Reuters news agency Iran would also refrain from retaliatory attacks for as long as the US held its fire.

"Iran's position remains 'attack for attack': if the attacks stop, Iran will also halt its operations," the official said, adding Iran remained prepared to respond if US attacks resumed.

Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said messages continued to be exchanged with the US through mediators, although he accused the US of previously having "betrayed" negotiations.

Before the latest pause, the US carried out a 13th consecutive night of strikes on Friday, targeting what the military said were Iranian command centres, drone storage facilities and maritime capabilities linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

Iranian state media reported at least four people were killed in the south-western province of Khuzestan, while Iran responded by launching drones and missiles towards US military facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan.

Authorities in Bahrain, Jordan and Kuwait said their air defence systems intercepted many of the attacks.

The pause comes as the financial and military toll of the conflict continues to grow.

Repeated Iranian attacks on US military bases across the Middle East have left parts of the US' regional military network heavily damaged.

The attacks have hit facilities in Kuwait, Jordan, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, with defence experts saying they have exposed vulnerabilities in sites once considered secure, and signalled a new chapter for the US' longstanding military strategy in the Middle East.

According to Pentagon figures, the war has already cost the United States US$37.5 billion ($53.6 billion), with politicians approving further military spending as concerns mount over the long-term impact on its defence capabilities.

title.en: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot dead by German police
title.zh: 柏林“骄傲”袭击嫌疑人被德国警方击毙

summary.en: The suspect had been known to the authorities for a "high number" of previous crimes and was believed to have been radicalised.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The suspect in the deadly Berlin Pride attack that left one person dead and 29 injured was shot and killed by police during a confrontation overnight, authorities said.

Abdul Ballout, a German citizen, was killed following a search that lasted nearly 24 hours after the attack in downtown Berlin.

Ballout, 21, was suspected of driving a van into a crowd near Berlin’s Pride festival on Saturday night (local time) before apparently stabbing others with a machete.

German interior minister Alexander Dobrindt said the attack occurred a few hundred metres from a party near the Brandenburg Gate that was supposed to close out the city's Pride festival.

Ballout was tracked down at around 2am AEST on Monday at a garden in Spandau, a Berlin suburb, the city's police department said in a post on X. They said he apparently ran toward officers with a sharp instrument, and police fired at least one shot. He died at the scene.

Ballout was born in Germany, the minister said. His mother was naturalised in 2002, three years before he was born.

Dobrindt said Ballout had been known to the authorities for a "high number" of previous crimes and for being radicalised.

"Everything we see here indicates that this was an Islamist terror attack," he said.

Prosecutors said Ballout had previous convictions for bodily harm and extortion committed in 2019, and one for robbery in 2020.

They say that in 2024 he shared IS propaganda on Instagram and the following year travelled to Lebanon in order to fight for the militia in Syria.

He was arrested in Lebanon and sentenced to three months' prison for offences including incitement to religious and sectarian conflict.

He returned to Germany after completing his sentence, where he was arrested at the Berlin airport.

In May, a juvenile court in Berlin convicted Ballout of preparing a serious act of violence endangering the state, as well as publishing the self-proclaimed Islamic State (IS) group's propaganda on his Instagram account and other charges, prosecutors said.

The court handed down a suspended sentence of one year and 10 months in youth custody, which Berlin prosecutors had appealed.

The court said it took Ballout’s months of pre-trial detention in Germany and Lebanon into account. It also said it considered that Ballout had confessed to the crimes, appeared to distance himself from the militant group, and no actual threat had ever materialised.

title.en: Christopher Street Day attack in Berlin: What we know so far
title.zh: 柏林克里斯托弗街日袭击：目前我们所知道的

summary.en: On Saturday, a vehicle drove into a crowd near Berlin Pride celebrations in what is being regarded as an attack on the LGBTQ+ community. The main suspect has since been confronted and shot dead.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On Saturday, a vehicle drove into a crowd near Berlin Pride celebrations in what is being regarded as an attack on the LGBTQ+ community. The main suspect has since been confronted and shot dead.

On Saturday night, around 10 pm, a white van drove into a crowd some 100 meters (328 feet) away from a Christopher Street Day celebration near Brandenburg Gate in the heart of Berlin. Police spokesperson Florian Nath said the van drove through the park parallel to a main road and struck a number of people before crashing into a tree. Afterward, the driver left the van and fled in an unknown direction, Nath said. 

Police later confirmed the vehicle was privately owned, not a rental. It was removed from the crime scene on Sunday.

Federal Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt (CDU) later added that a suspect is also believed to have attacked people with a blade-like weapon, possibly a machete, before fleeing.

The area around the crime scene was widely blocked off Saturday night after organizers called off the rest of the event and evacuated festivalgoers. Police searched the Tiergarten area with infrared cameras overnight, spokesperson Nath said.

One woman died following the attack, and 29 people were injured — several of them severely.

"This is an attack on our society," German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on social media in response to the attack, which he called "heinous." The people struck were near a closing party of the Christopher Street Day parade, which celebrates LGBTQ+ rights .

By Sunday afternoon, police confirmed that none of those injured were in life-threatening condition anymore.

Eyewitness accounts initially suggested that multiple attackers were involved, leading the police to search for more than one perpetrator at first. 

Interior Minister Dobrindt said Sunday the chief suspect was Abdul B., 21, who had been known to authorities for a "high number" of previous attacks, and for being radicalized. In accordance with the German press code, Deutsche Welle refrains from publishing the full name of criminal suspects.

Prosecutors say Abdul B. shared propaganda for the so-called Islamic State (or  IS ) militant group online and had recently unsuccessfully attempted to join the group in Syria.

He later distanced himself from IS. Abdul B. was born in Germany and held German citizenship. His mother has Lebanese origins. 

On Sunday evening, Berlin's Senate Department for Interior Affairs told media the fugitive suspect Abdul B. was shot dead in a police operation in a garden allotment in Spandau, Berlin's westernmost borough. The interior minister has since said there was no longer any danger to the public.

title.en: Australia's favourite holiday destination is undergoing a hidden transformation
title.zh: 澳大利亚人最喜爱的度假胜地正在经历一场隐秘的变革

summary.en: Bali's waste crisis is colliding with a boom in tourists, and the Indonesian government has plans to reel in more rich visitors.
summary.zh: 巴厘岛的垃圾危机正与旅游业的蓬勃发展相冲突，而印度尼西亚政府计划吸引更多富裕游客。

body.en:
Since Bali's main landfill site, Suwung, closed in April, bags of rubbish and single-use plastics have piled up in the streets, on the beaches and in the canals.

"The air is no longer fresh; the views are clouded by haze; and the sweet scent of frangipani has been replaced by the acrid smell of burning plastic," Balinese writer Sugi Lanus posted on social media.

In June the Balinese government partially reopened the landfill to organic waste, limited to two days a week. Officials had wanted to close it for years, as the central Indonesian government pushes to end open-air waste dumping.

At the same time, tourism to Bali has hit an all-time peak. Last year, visitors increased by nearly 10 per cent to hit just under seven million visitors.

Australians made up 1.6 million of those, according to the government's statistics bureau.

But as Indonesia paves the way for more tourists, with a master plan to transform Bali into the "Dubai" of Southeast Asia, it's the local communities who are left to shoulder the burden of Bali's environmental emergency.

Made Suarnatha, who started environmental NGO Wisnu Foundation in Bali in 1993, told SBS News Bali's waste crisis was "a political issue".

He said the landfill closure masked an existing problem with the transition from mostly organic waste to plastic waste — a problem intensified by tourism.

"You come here as a tourist, you need food, you need water, you make trips here and there, so you bring waste as a consequence," he said.

"It's no big issue when we talk about waste which is mostly organic, but the tourism industry comes, and the character of the waste changes to packaging with plastic, cardboard, metal, and everything," he said.

"It changed its character without being followed by an understanding of how to handle it."

Putu Natih, an economist at Universitas Indonesia, grew up visiting family in Bali.

She told SBS News that of the roughly 3,436 tonnes of waste generated every day in Bali, around 40 per cent is burned or illegally dumped.

"The failure is more likely structural rather than behavioural. The regulation exists, but the collection and processing infrastructure to back it up does not," Natih said.

On 12 July, environmental group Wahli Bali and student activists Frontier Bali staged a protest in the Bali capital Denpasar calling for a moratorium on tourism until the waste crisis had been addressed, also campaigning against what they see as water and land-use crises.

title.en: Berlin CSD: Latest in string of deadly vehicle attacks
title.zh: 柏林骄傲节：最新一系列致命车辆袭击事件

summary.en: An attack at a Berlin Pride event, where a vehicle was used as a weapon, is the latest in a series of similar incidents globally. Reports indicate that the US, Canada, and China have also experienced such attacks in recent years.
summary.zh: 柏林骄傲节活动中发生了一起车辆袭击事件，这是近年来车辆被用作武器的致命袭击事件中的最新一起。据报道，美国、加拿大和中国近年来也发生了类似的袭击。

body.en:
The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.

A Christopher Street Day event in the German capital, which attracts thousands of people every year, was attacked on Saturday night by a 21-year-old suspect who police said was associated with the "Islamist scene" in Berlin. One person was killed and another 16 people were injured, while the suspect, named as Abdul B., fled the scene.

Two people were killed and 20 more injured in early May when a car drove through a crowd in the eastern German city of Leipzig. The suspect in the case was described as a 33-year-old German national and local resident, who had been known to police, though not for relevant offenses.

At least two people were killed and several were injured in the southwestern German city of Mannheim in 2025 when a motorist intentionally drove his car into a crowd of people , according to police and public prosecutors. Authorities identified the suspect as a 40-year-old German man. Law enforcement ruled out a political motive at the time, though the man had paid a fine under Germany's hate crime laws for a comment he made on a social media platform in 2018.

A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old daughter were killed in Munich in February last year when a car was rammed into a demonstration organized by the trade union Verdi. A 25-year-old Afghan man subsequently went on trial for their murder, as well as the attempted murder of the dozens of other people injured in the attack. 

A vehicle plowed into a crowd of New Orleans revelers early on New Year's Day 2025, killing 14 people and injuring dozens of others. The driver of the vehicle and two police officers were killed in a firefight soon after the attack, which took place at about 3:15 in the morning local time. The FBI said it was investigating the incident as an act of terrorism.

At least six people died and more than 300 were injured when a man slammed a rented BMW SUV into a Christmas market in eastern Germany. The suspect, who was arrested at the scene, was a 50-year-old doctor originally from Saudi Arabia who had expressed anti-Muslim views and support for the far-right AfD party. In June 2026, he was sentenced to life in prison, with the court noting the severity of his crime, which more or less rules out the possibility of an early release.

A 62-year-old driver  rammed a small SUV into people exercising at a sports complex in southern China on November 11, 2024, killing 38 people in the country's deadliest act of mass homicide in years. Another 48 were injured. Authorities said the perpetrator was upset...
body.zh: 柏林骄傲活动中的袭击只是一长串将车辆用作武器的事件中的最新一起。近年来，美国、加拿大和中国也发生过类似的攻击。 德国首都的克里斯托弗街日活动每年都会吸引数千人参加，周六晚上，该活动遭到一名 21 岁嫌疑人的袭击，警方称该嫌疑人与柏林的“伊斯兰主义现场”有关。造成 1 人死亡、16 人受伤，嫌疑人 Abdul B. 逃离现场。 5 月初，德国东部城市莱比锡一辆汽车驶过人群，造成两人死亡、二十多人受伤。据描述，该案嫌疑人是一名 33 岁的德国国民和当地居民，警方认识他，但并未因相关罪行而认识他。 据警方和检察官称，2025 年，德国西南部城市曼海姆一名驾车者故意驾车冲撞人群，造成至少两人死亡、多人受伤。 当局确认嫌疑人是一名 40 岁的德国男子。执法部门当时排除了政治动机，尽管该男子因 2018 年在社交媒体平台上发表的评论而根据德国仇恨犯罪法缴纳了罚款。 去年2月，慕尼黑工会威尔第组织的一场示威活动中，一辆汽车被撞，导致一名37岁的妇女和她两岁的女儿丧生。一名 25 岁的阿富汗男子随后因谋杀以及企图谋杀袭击中受伤的其他数十人而接受审判。 2025 年元旦早些时候，一辆汽车冲撞了新奥尔良狂欢者的人群，造成 14 人死亡、数十人受伤。袭击发生在当地时间凌晨 3 点 15 分左右，车辆司机和两名警察在袭击发生后不久的交火中丧生。 联邦调查局表示，正在将此事件作为恐怖主义行为进行调查。 一名男子将一辆租来的宝马 SUV 撞向德国东部的圣诞市场，造成至少 6 人死亡、300 多人受伤。现场被捕的嫌疑人是一名来自沙特阿拉伯的 50 岁医生，曾表达反穆斯林观点并支持极右翼选择党。 2026 年 6 月，他被判处终身监禁，法院注意到他罪行的严重性，这或多或少排除了提前释放的可能性。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，一名 62 岁的司机驾驶一辆小型 SUV 撞向在中国南方一个体育场馆锻炼的人们，造成 38 人死亡，这是该国多年来最致命的大规模凶杀案。另有 48 人受伤。当局表示，肇事者情绪激动……

reflection.en: The news of vehicle attacks, like the one in Berlin, reminds us of the profound pain and fear that deliberate acts of violence inflict on communities. In moments of such tragedy, our hearts long for a world where suffering, mourning, and death are no more. Yahweh promises a future where every tear will be wiped away, and all former things of pain will pass,...
reflection.zh: 柏林发生的车辆袭击事件提醒我们，蓄意暴力行为给社区带来了深切的痛苦和恐惧。在这样的悲剧时刻，我们的心渴望一个不再有苦难、悲伤和死亡的世界。雅伟应许了一个未来，在那里祂将擦去所有的眼泪，一切旧有的痛苦都将过去，为我们当前的悲伤提供了坚定的盼望。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
title.zh: 巴控克什米尔选举能否平息紧张局势？

summary.en: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is preparing for elections following weeks of deadly protests. These demonstrations were sparked by disputes over parliamentary seats designated for individuals displaced from India-administered Kashmir, with one local faction advocating for an election boycott.
summary.zh: 巴控克什米尔地区在经历数周致命抗议后将举行选举。这些抗议活动源于对为印控克什米尔流离失所者保留的议会席位的争议，当地一个团体呼吁抵制此次选举。

body.en:
Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the elections to be boycotted.

The first phase of local elections in Pakistan-administered Kashmir is scheduled for Monday, July 27, amid calls for a boycott from the recently outlawed Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), a grassroots alliance of civil society groups.

The JAAC has been demanding the abolition of 12 seats in the regional assembly reserved for people displaced from India-administered Kashmir and living in Pakistan. The group argues that only residents of Pakistan-administered Kashmir should be eligible to contest regional elections.

The dispute escalated after the Supreme Court of Pakistan-administered Kashmir ruled that the refugee seats are constitutionally protected and cannot be abolished without a constitutional amendment.

The regional government outlawed the JAAC in June under anti-terrorism laws, citing threats to public order, and detained dozens of its supporters.

The ban came amid rising tensions over the refugee seats and ahead of violent protests sparked by the group's campaign to scrap them.

The unrest has left around 30 people dead since June, according to local estimates cited by Reuters news agency.

India and Pakistan both claim Kashmir in its entirety, but each country only controls a section of the territory, making the Muslim-majority region a longstanding flash point between the nuclear-armed neighbors since their independence from Britain in 1947.

Since early June, Pakistan-administered Kashmir — known locally as Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) — has witnessed weeks of protests and sit-ins. While the dispute over the refugee seats has become a major issue, JAAC has also campaigned for broader economic and governance reforms. 

Following the unrest, authorities split polling into three phases, with voting in Mirpur set for July 27 and elections in the protest-hit Poonch division postponed until August 10.

Voting in the regional capital, Muzaffarabad, has been delayed until August 2 over security concerns. The JAAC continues to stage a sit-in in Rawalakot, near the Line of Control with India.

A major question is whether the elections can restore public confidence or merely offer a temporary pause in public anger.

"We are just asking for fair representation, which is our right," Ali Raza, a 22-year-old student protester in Rawalakot, told DW. "The local people who live here should have the right to choose their representatives, not the refugees who settled here from India."

"The election is a major opportunity for the people of AJK to choose their representatives," said Shazia Marri, the central information...
body.zh: 在为印控克什米尔流离失所者保留席位而发生数周致命抗议后，巴控克什米尔即将举行投票。一个当地团体呼吁抵制选举。 巴控克什米尔的第一阶段地方选举定于 7 月 27 日星期一举行，最近被取缔的查谟克​​什米尔联合人民行动委员会 (JAAC)（一个民间社会团体的草根联盟）呼吁抵制。 JAAC一直要求废除地区议会中为印控克什米尔流离失所者和居住在巴基斯坦的人保留的12个席位。该组织认为，只有巴控克什米尔的居民才有资格参加地区选举。 巴控克什米尔最高法院裁定难民席位受宪法保护，未经宪法修正案不得废除，争端升级。 6月，地方政府以公共秩序威胁为由，根据反恐法取缔了JAAC，并拘留了数十名其支持者。 这项禁令出台之际，围绕难民席位的紧张局势不断加剧，且该组织废除难民席位的运动引发了暴力抗议。 据路透社援引当地估计，自 6 月以来，骚乱已造成约 30 人死亡。 印度和巴基斯坦都声称对整个克什米尔拥有主权，但两国仅控制着该地区的一部分，这使得这个穆斯林占多数的地区自 1947 年脱离英国独立以来一直成为这两个拥有核武器的邻国之间的冲突点。 自六月初以来，巴控克什米尔——当地称为自由查谟和克什米尔（AJK）——见证了持续数周的抗议和静坐。虽然难民席位争议已成为一个主要问题，但 JAAC 还致力于进行更广泛的经济和治理改革。 骚乱发生后，当局将投票分为三个阶段，米尔布尔的投票定于 7 月 27 日进行，而遭受抗议活动的庞奇区的选举则推迟至 8 月 10 日。 出于安全考虑，地区首府穆扎法拉巴德的投票已推迟至 8 月 2 日。 JAAC 继续在印度控制线附近的拉瓦拉科特举行静坐。 一个主要问题是，选举能否恢复公众信心，或者只是暂时平息公众的愤怒。 “我们只是要求公平的代表权，这是我们的权利，”拉瓦拉科特的 22 岁学生抗议者阿里·拉扎 (Ali Raza) 告诉德国之声。 “居住在这里的当地人应该有权选择他们的代表，而不是从印度定居在这里的难民。” 中央新闻社沙齐亚·马里（Shazia Marri）表示：“这次选举是 AJK 人民选择代表的重大机会。”

reflection.en: The ongoing tensions and protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir highlight the deep divisions that can arise between communities, especially concerning the rights and representation of displaced people. Yahweh, through Christ, offers a vision where walls of hostility are broken down, making two groups one. This reminds us that true peace comes not just...
reflection.zh: 巴控克什米尔地区持续的紧张局势和抗议活动，凸显了社区之间可能出现的深刻分歧，尤其是在流离失所者的权利和代表权问题上。雅伟通过基督提供了一个愿景，即敌意的墙被拆毁，使两个群体合而为一。这提醒我们，真正的和平不仅来自政治进程，更来自一项神圣的工作，它能使疏远的内心和民族和解。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
title.zh: 苏丹内战：平民被用作‘人肉盾牌’

summary.en: The humanitarian situation in El Obeid, Sudan, is deteriorating, with reports of civilians being used as 'human shields' and children suffering trauma, unable to attend school. Rights organizations are warning of widespread atrocities.
summary.zh: 苏丹被围困城市埃尔奥贝德的人道主义局势日益恶化，人权组织警告可能发生大规模暴行。平民被用作‘人肉盾牌’，儿童遭受创伤，不敢上学。

body.en:
The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.

Flattened houses and rubble where a school once stood: These are the scenes that have appeared in footage of the Sudanese city of El Obeid published by Ayin Network, a nonpartisan Sudanese media outlet. Drone attacks by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have caused enormous damage to civilian infrastructure, including power grids, transformers, water treatment plants, schools, universities and hospitals in the capital of North Kordofan.

The local population is struggling to survive,  according to Ahmed Awad, project manager for the UK children's rights organization Plan International, and a native of El Obeid. The city — whose population previously numbered half a million but has now become home to several hundred thousand internally displaced persons (IDP) — is under siege, he added.

There is a shortage of medical supplies as well as food and safe, clean water, and Awad said he saw long queues of IDPs at just one water pump: "Sometimes you can spend all day to get one liter of water for two or three days."

He added that a drone had hit a primary school and killed three children, which had caused trauma among other children, many of whom no longer dared go to school.

"One of the mothers said three of her children cannot sleep because always they are in fear of something happening again," he said, adding that Plan International tried "to provide psychosocial support" for people scared of drones that could hit a classroom at any time.

El Obeid is a strategically important location. The city is a trading hub in the middle of the desert on the only major route between Sudan's capital, Khartoum — which is controlled by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) — and the western Darfur region, large parts of which are under the control of the RSF. Since the war began in 2023, the city has been captured by the RSF and recaptured by the army and allied militias many times.

El Obeid is currently controlled by the army, which has some 13,000 soldiers stationed there, and has been on the front line since fighting shifted from Darfur to Kordofan at the beginning of the year. The RSF has deployed troops to about 30 kilometers (18.6 miles) beyond the city limits, and has been using drones to bomb civilian infrastructure.

body.zh: 苏丹被围困城市埃尔奥贝德的局势日益恶化，人权组织警告可能发生大规模暴行。孩子们受到创伤，不敢上学。 曾经有一所学校矗立的房屋和瓦砾被夷为平地：这些场景出现在苏丹无党派媒体 Ayin Network 发布的苏丹城市埃尔奥贝德的镜头中。准军事快速支援部队（RSF）的无人机袭击对北科尔多凡州首府的民用基础设施造成了巨大破坏，包括电网、变压器、水处理厂、学校、大学和医院。 英国儿童权利组织国际计划的项目经理、土生土长的埃尔奥贝德艾哈迈德·阿瓦德表示，当地居民正在为生存而苦苦挣扎。他补充说，这座城市以前有 50 万人口，但现在已成为数十万国内流离失所者 (IDP) 的家园。 医疗用品、食品和安全清洁的水都短缺，阿瓦德说，他看到国内流离失所者在一个水泵前排起了长队：“有时你需要花一整天的时间才能获得两三天的一升水。” 他补充说，一架无人机袭击了一所小学，导致三名儿童死亡，这给其他儿童造成了创伤，其中许多人不再敢去上学。 “其中一位母亲说，她的三个孩子睡不着，因为他们总是担心再次发生什么事情，”他说，并补充说，国际计划试图为那些担心随时可能袭击教室的无人机的人们“提供社会心理支持”。 埃尔奥贝德是一个具有重要战略意义的地点。 这座城市是沙漠中部的一个贸易中心，位于苏丹首都喀土穆（由苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 控制）和西达尔富尔地区（其中大部分地区由无国界部队控制）之间的唯一主要路线上。自2023年战争爆发以来，这座城市多次被无国界医生组织占领，并多次被军队和盟军民兵收复。 埃尔奥贝德目前由军队控制，军队驻扎在那里约 13,000 名士兵，自从年初战事从达尔富尔转移到科尔多凡以来，奥贝德一直处于前线。无国界医生组织已将部队部署到城市边界外约 30 公里（18.6 英里）处，并一直在使用无人机轰炸民用基础设施。 分析人士、援助组织和联合国警告说，无国界医生组织可能很快就会抓获埃尔奥贝德。他们担心会出现与 2025 年 10 月邻近的北达尔富尔州法希尔市类似的情况，当时……

summary.en: Four decades after he and George Michael became the first western pop act to tour the country, Ridgeley recalls silent gigs, awkward embassy receptions – and the ‘bloody ludicrous’ hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director There has always been something surreal about Wham!’s 1985...

body.en: Four decades after he and George Michael became the first western pop act to tour the country, Ridgeley recalls silent gigs, awkward embassy receptions – and the ‘bloody ludicrous’ hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director There has always been something surreal about Wham!’s 1985 trip to China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley looked like alien visitors on the streets of Beijing, their bouffant hair and flamboyant outfits setting them apart from the Mao jackets and drab uniforms of the Chinese people they encountered. Now the full strangeness of the duo’s brief trip, which made them the first western pop act to play in the country, is explored in a fascinating documentary film, Wham! 10 Days in China. Using previously unseen archive footage and featuring new interviews with many of the people involved in the tour, it shows the extraordinary impact Wham!’s two concerts had on their Chinese audience, as well as providing a snapshot of a country on the brink of great change. Police said they received numerous calls after multi-storey scaffolding along Cheung Sha Wan Road collapsed in powerful winds on Saturday. No injuries have been reported.

Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China on Sunday morning, lashing the region with strong winds and heavy rain and forcing Hong Kong airport to cancel around 360 passenger flights.

title.en: From the strait of Hormuz to the North Sea, a global maritime war rages around us – and more than the price of oil is at stake | Simon Tisdall

summary.en: A recent report highlights the breakdown of international maritime cooperation, warning of a global maritime conflict extending from the Strait of Hormuz to the North Sea. body.en: The collapse of the rules-based order is not confined to the land: we’re imperilled as centuries of maritime cooperation sink beneath the waves The US military campaign to protect merchant shipping from Iranian attacks by asserting direct maritime control in the strait of Hormuz is not an idea unique to Donald Trump’s administration. Almost exactly 200 years ago, in the period 1825-27, a powerful US naval squadron led by Commodore John Rodgers was sent to the Mediterranean to defend American ships from the depredations of Greek corsairs and pirates. For all the new-minted republic’s brave talk of liberty, the US squadron did not assist Greece’s ongoing “regime change” struggle for independence from the Ottoman empire. Its sole, self-serving purpose was to defend US trade, markets and business interests. After abandoning his call for a people’s revolution in Tehran , this, too, is what Trump’s reckless war with Iran has now boiled down to. title.en: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea, 17 missing
title.zh: 越南船只在南海沉没，17人失踪

summary.en: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.
summary.zh: 一艘载有62名船员的越南籍货船在南海永暑礁附近沉没，导致17人失踪。南海是世界上最重要且争议不断的海域之一。

body.en:
A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.

Rescuers were searching on Sunday for 17 people missing after a Vietnamese ship sank in the South China Sea , China's ⁠state media reported.

Authorities in the Chinese island province of Hainan said the cargo vessel Khoi ​Nguyen 18 ran into trouble near Yongshu Reef, also known as Fiery Cross Reef, state broadcaster CCTV said.

The ship was carrying 62 crew members, and 45 people were rescued from the water.

Vietnamese authorities arrived at the scene immediately after the cargo ship "sank while operating in bad weather conditions in the East Sea," Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said in a statement to AFP news agency.

A Chinese rescue ship, the Nanhai Jiu 115, first spotted what was believed to be a distress flare from the vessel shortly before 6:30 pm on Saturday (1030 GMT).

The Khoi Nguyen 18 is a Vietnamese-registered ship measuring just under 70 meters (230 feet) in length, according to state news agency Xinhua.

It added that six Chinese vessels, a rescue helicopter and a Vietnamese vessel were involved in the search-and-rescue operations.

Hang said that authorities and fishing vessels were "actively searching for the remaining people."

Beijing claims sovereignty over almost the entire South China Sea, despite the 2016 international ruling, initiated by the Philippines against China, that its assertion has no legal basis.

One of the most highly contested areas is the ​ Spratly Islands , which China calls the Nansha Islands, where China has built runways ⁠and militarized artificial islands.

But ​Beijing's sweeping claims to the busy waterway overlap with those of other countries, including Vietnam, the Philippines, Brunei, Malaysia and Taiwan .

title.en: Typhoon Noul forces more than 715,000 from homes and cancels hundreds of flights in China and Hong Kong
title.zh: 台风“诺尔”迫使逾71.5万人撤离家园，中港数百航班取消

summary.en: Typhoon Noul, the strongest to hit China this year, made landfall over the weekend, bringing severe winds and heavy rain to southern China and Hong Kong. The storm forced over 715,000 people from their homes and led to hundreds of flight cancellations.
summary.zh: 今年迄今为止登陆中国的最强台风“诺尔”于周末登陆，给华南地区和香港带来了强风暴雨。这场风暴导致超过71.5万人被迫撤离家园，数百趟航班被取消。

body.en:
Typhoon Noul made landfall early Sunday bringing strong winds and heavy rain to southern China, including Hong Kong , over the weekend.

It prompted the evacuation of hundreds of thousands of people in Guangdong province with the region on high alert and hundreds of flights cancelled.

The typhoon – the strongest to make landfall in China so far this year – will dump heavy to torrential rains across much of southern China for two days, authorities said, after ⁠sweeping the province of ⁠Guangdong ​and neighbouring Hong Kong with gale-force winds.

The ⁠year’s 12th tropical cyclone and China’s third this month, Noul, which ​means the glow of sunrise ‌or sunset in Korean, struck ‌the coast of Huidong county about 3:50 am, officials ‌said.

It is expected to bring strong winds and heavy rain to nearby provinces such as Jiangxi and Hunan as it moves inland, state media said, with the rains likely to persist until Tuesday.

Extremely heavy to exceptional downpours are expected to lash some areas including the ‌province of Fujian, as the National Meteorological Centre forecast heavy to torrential rain from Sunday until Monday morning across ​much of China’s south.

Authorities urged local governments to pay special attention to flood-prone areas such as zones of mountains and rivers, building sites, valleys and bridges.

Hong Kong’s Observatory said Noul, with maximum sustained winds of 110 km/h (68 mph) near its centre, was moving Sunday into inland Guangdong and weakening progressively.

More than 715,000 people had been relocated for safety in Guangdong province, according to state media. Train services in the province were cancelled for Sunday, according to China News Service.

China’s National Meteorological Center expected parts of southern Guangdong and south-eastern Fujian provinces to experience heavy rain and strong winds. Many trees were seen uprooted in Huilai county, located on the coast of Guangdong province, state broadcaster CCTV reported.

Hong Kong’s airport authority said about 350 flights were cancelled Sunday. At least nine people were injured across the city during the typhoon period, according to authorities. Officials said flights will gradually begin resuming on Sunday afternoon.

As Noul approached Hong Kong, parts of a large scaffolding on a high-rise building collapsed on Saturday, police said, although initial reports indicated there were no injuries.

Taiwan’s Central Weather Administration said Noul was bringing rainfall to parts of southern and eastern Taiwan. It was passing over waters south of Taiwan, and was moving away from the island on Saturday.

body.zh: 台风诺尔周日早些时候登陆，周末给包括香港在内的中国南部地区带来强风和大雨。 这促使广东省数十万人撤离，该地区处于高度戒备状态，数百个航班被取消。 当局表示，这场台风是今年迄今为止在中国登陆的最强台风，在强风席卷广东省和邻近的香港后，将为中国南方大部分地区带来持续两天的强降雨。 官员称，今年第 12 个热带气旋、本月中国第 3 个热带气旋“努尔”（韩语的意思是日出或日落的光芒）于凌晨 3 点 50 分左右袭击了惠东县海岸。 官方媒体称，随着它向内陆移动，预计将给江西和湖南等附近省份带来强风和暴雨，降雨可能会持续到周二。 国家气象中心预计，从周日到周一上午，中国南方大部分地区将有大到暴雨，预计包括福建省在内的部分地区将出现特大到特大暴雨。 有关部门敦促地方政府特别关注山地河流、建筑工地、山谷和桥梁等洪水易发地区。 香港天文台表示，努尔中心附近的最大持续风速为每小时 110 公里（每小时 68 英里），周日正向广东内陆移动，并逐渐减弱。 据官方媒体报道，广东省已有超过 715,000 人被转移到安全地点。据中新社报道，周日该省的火车服务被取消。 中国国家气象中心预计，广东南部、福建东南部等地部分地区将有大雨、大风。据中央电视台报道，位于广东省沿海的惠来县，许多树木被连根拔起。 香港机场管理局表示，周日约有 350 架航班被取消。据当局称，台风期间全市至少有九人受伤。官员们表示，航班将于周日下午逐步恢复。 警方表示，当努尔接近香港时，一座高层建筑的大型脚手架的部分设施倒塌，不过初步报告显示无人受伤。 台湾中央气象局表示，努尔将为台湾南部和东部部分地区带来降雨。它当时正飞越台湾以南海域，并于周六远离台湾岛。 本月早些时候，台风“巴威”给中国东部带来强风暴雨，导致超过200万人疏散。它于7月11日登陆。其他，...

reflection.en: A powerful typhoon displacing hundreds of thousands reminds us of our vulnerability to natural forces. In such moments of crisis and uncertainty, we are invited to find our refuge and strength in Yahweh. Even when homes are threatened and plans disrupted, His presence remains a steadfast help.
reflection.zh: 强大的台风导致数十万人流离失所，这提醒我们人类在大自然力量面前的脆弱。在这样的危机和不确定时刻，我们被邀请在雅伟那里找到我们的避难所和力量。即使家园受到威胁，计划被打乱，祂的同在仍然是坚定的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: How Chinese tech and Russian tactics are aiding Iran’s bombing of US bases
title.zh: 中国科技和俄罗斯战术如何助力伊朗轰炸美军基地

summary.en: A report indicates that Iran's attacks on US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf are becoming more accurate and lethal, with assistance from Chinese technology and Russian tactics. This escalation is revealing vulnerabilities in existing defenses in the region.
summary.zh: 一份报告指出，伊朗对海湾地区美军基地和关键基础设施的袭击正变得越来越精准和致命，这得益于中国的技术和俄罗斯的战术。此次升级暴露了该地区现有防御的弱点。

body.en: Increasingly accurate and lethal attacks are revealing weaknesses in stretched defences across the Gulf As the crisis in the Middle East escalates, Iran has been bombing US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf with increasing accuracy, helped by Chinese satellite imagery and tactics learned by Russia in Ukraine. Three US soldiers were killed last Friday in an attack on the Muwaffaq Salti airbase in Jordan, which was being protected by a Thaad air defence system. Satellite imagery later released by Iranian media showed several buildings had been destroyed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 越来越准确和致命的袭击暴露了整个海湾地区紧张防御的弱点随着中东危机升级，在中国卫星图像和俄罗斯在乌克兰学到的战术的帮助下，伊朗一直在以越来越高的精度轰炸美国在海湾的基地和关键基础设施。上周五，约旦穆瓦法克萨尔蒂空军基地遭到萨德防空系统保护，三名美国士兵在袭击中丧生。伊朗媒体后来发布的卫星图像显示，多座建筑物被毁。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of escalating, more lethal attacks in the Gulf, aided by advanced technology, highlights the ongoing human tendency to refine the instruments of conflict. Isaiah's ancient vision of nations transforming weapons into tools for peace offers a profound contrast to the current reality of improving the means of war. It reminds us to long for a future...
reflection.zh: 海湾地区袭击升级，在先进技术辅助下变得更具杀伤力的消息，凸显了人类不断完善冲突工具的倾向。以赛亚书将武器转化为和平工具的古老愿景，与当前不断改进战争手段的现实形成了深刻对比。它提醒我们，要渴望一个将智慧用于建设而非毁灭的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Mass job cuts loom at VW as profits fall steeply on China sales slump
title.zh: 大众汽车因中国销量下滑利润锐减，面临大规模裁员

summary.en: Volkswagen has reported a significant drop in profits and reduced its revenue forecast, primarily due to a sales slump in China. The German carmaker is implementing a restructuring program that could lead to the elimination of 100,000 jobs globally.
summary.zh: 大众汽车公布利润大幅下滑并下调营收预期，主要原因是其在中国市场的销量锐减。这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项重组计划，可能导致全球裁员10万人。

body.en: Carmaker expects to sell 3% fewer vehicles this year as it pushes through a programme that could eliminate 100,000 roles Volkswagen has reported a steep fall in profits and cut its revenue forecast amid a sales slump in China, as the German carmaker pushes through a brutal cost-cutting programme that includes axeing up to 100,000 jobs. VW said it expects sales revenue to fall by up to 3% this year, a reversal of a previous forecast for a 3% increase on last year’s €321.9bn (£275.3bn), because of a sales slump in the highly competitive Chinese market. Continue reading...
body.zh: 汽车制造商预计今年的汽车销量将减少 3%，因为该公司正在推行一项可能裁减 10 万名员工的计划。大众汽车公司报告称，由于中国销量下滑，大众汽车公司利润大幅下滑，并下调了收入预期，因为这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项残酷的成本削减计划，其中包括裁员多达 10 万名。大众表示，由于竞争激烈的中国市场销量下滑，预计今年销售收入将下降 3%，与去年 3,219 亿欧元（2,753 亿英镑）相比增长 3% 的预测相反。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of economic uncertainty and job insecurity, it's easy to feel that our worth is tied to our employment. This verse reminds us that all work, when done with diligence and integrity, can be an offering to Yahweh, giving it a deeper purpose beyond earthly outcomes. For those facing job loss, remembering this truth can be a source of dignity and hope,...
reflection.zh: 在经济不确定和就业不稳的时期，我们很容易觉得自己的价值与工作挂钩。这节经文提醒我们，所有工作，只要勤勉正直地去做，都可以是献给雅伟的供物，使其拥有超越世俗结果的更深层意义。对于那些面临失业的人来说，记住这个真理可以成为尊严和希望的源泉，因为他们知道自己的劳动具有永恒的价值。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Weather tracker: More than 900 wildfires rage across Canada
title.zh: 天气追踪：加拿大900多处野火肆虐

summary.en: More than 900 wildfires are currently burning across Canada, with many out of control in the Northwest Territories and Ontario. Recent hot, dry weather has contributed to the fires, which have already scorched approximately 3 million hectares.
summary.zh: 加拿大目前有超过900处野火正在燃烧，其中西北地区和安大略省的许多火势仍未得到控制。近期炎热干燥的天气助长了火势，已烧毁约300万公顷土地。

body.en: Fires remain out of control in Northwest Territories and Ontario, while Argentina endures record night-time heat Recent hot, dry weather in Canada has triggered hundreds of wildfires across the country. As of Wednesday, more than 900 were burning, scorching about 3m hectares of land. While fires have broken out in several provinces, the greatest concern is in the Northwest Territories and Ontario , where several remain out of control. Poor air quality has been reported across affected regions, with wildfire smoke carried by winds into the US and even across the Atlantic to northern Europe. The risk of further blazes remains high as North America enters the peak of fire season. Continue reading...
body.zh: 西北地区和安大略省的火灾仍处于失控状态，而阿根廷则经历了创纪录的夜间高温。加拿大最近炎热干燥的天气在全国引发了数百起野火。截至周三，已有 900 多个火点在燃烧，烧焦了约 300 万公顷的土地。虽然多个省份都爆发了火灾，但最令人担忧的是西北地区和安大略省，其中有几处火灾仍处于失控状态。据报道，受影响地区的空气质量很差，野火烟雾随风进入美国，甚至跨越大西洋到达北欧。随着北美进入火灾季节高峰，进一步发生火灾的风险仍然很高。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires across Canada, consuming millions of hectares, remind us of creation's deep vulnerability and its 'groaning' under the weight of environmental distress. In these moments of ecological crisis, we are called to lament with the Earth and seek ways to care for the world Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 加拿大各地蔓延的野火吞噬了数百万公顷土地，这提醒我们受造界的脆弱，以及它在环境困境重压下的“叹息”。在这些生态危机时刻，我们受召与大地一同哀叹，并寻求方法来照管雅伟托付给我们的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

body.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正在迅速缩小与美国同行的差距，引发了特朗普政府的新威胁。随着知识产权盗窃的指控，紧张局势会升级吗？ 似乎一眨眼的功夫，中国在顶级人工智能 (AI) 领域就从落后美国五年变为仅落后几个月。 尽管包括 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 在内的美国企业已经花费了数千亿美元来推动人工智能的前沿发展，但中国却走了一条截然不同的道路。 面对美国对帮助人工智能实现最先进思维的高端芯片的限制，中国科技公司优先考虑了数十种基于“足够好”技术的开源人工智能模型。 这些平台，包括 DeepSeek、阿里巴巴的 Qwen 和小米的 MiMo，现已广泛部署在中国企业、政府服务和消费设备中。 作为缩小差距的最新迹象，中国初创公司 Moonshot AI 上周推出了 Kimi K3，该模型在关键基准测试上可与最先进的人工智能模型之一——Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 相媲美。 在某些测试中，Kimi K3 可以与 Claude 相媲美甚至超过 Claude，但其计算能力却要低得多，而成本却只是 Claude 的一小部分。 全球技术专家 Alvin W. Graylin 认为 Kimi K3 的到来将高端人工智能从昂贵的奢侈品变成了实用且负担得起的东西。 “对于 98% 的客户来说，[知识] 1% 到 2% 的差异并不值得多付 10 到 20 倍的费用。” 中国的最新进展已经引起华盛顿的强烈反应，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普现在威胁要阻止美国使用中国的人工智能模型。 与此同时，财政部长斯科特·贝森特本周早些时候警告称，美国可能会因涉嫌盗窃知识产权而制裁中国模型。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 指责中国实验室使用他们的模型来训练他们自己的系统，这一过程被称为蒸馏。 虽然提炼是全球人工智能实验室在一定程度上的常见做法，但这些公司表示，他们的模型已经受到查询的轰炸，以收获高级推理。白宫四月份警告说，中国正在以“工业规模”这样做。 北京方面予以反击，否认这些指控毫无根据，并称美国威胁实施制裁和示范禁令是“技术欺凌”，旨在遏制中国的崛起。 华盛顿智库史汀生中心战略远见中心的研究分析师朱莉娅·尼赫（Giulia Neaher）淡化了提炼在基米进步中的作用。 “[其成功]很大程度上归功于为建设这个项目而投入的人才、基础设施和资源......

reflection.en: In a world of intense technological competition and rising international tensions, the call to live peaceably with all people becomes profoundly relevant. Even amidst accusations and threats, seeking paths to de-escalation and mutual respect is vital for global stability. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to pursue peace wherever possible, even when faced with...
reflection.zh: 在科技竞争激烈、国际关系日益紧张的世界中，与所有人和平相处的呼召变得至关重要。即使面对指控和威胁，寻求缓和局势和相互尊重的途径对全球稳定也至关重要。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们，即使面对竞争，也要尽可能追求和平。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test
title.zh: “强烈关切”：澳大利亚在中国弹道导弹试验后与中方会晤

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

body.en:
The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) says taxpayers with straightforward tax affairs can now begin lodging their tax returns, with most income statements and pre-fill information now available.

More than 100 million pieces of data from employers, banks, private health insurers, share registries and government agencies have been loaded into the ATO's systems to help people lodge more accurately and with less effort.

ATO assistant commissioner Anita Challen released a statement saying that most income statements and pre-fill information is now available.

"If you're self-lodging, before you hit submit, take a few extra minutes to check your details to avoid delays and mistakes," she said.

The ATO is also expanding its pre-fill services this year to include income reported through the Taxable Payment Annual Report.

From late August, contractors in some industries — including construction, cleaning, courier services, information technology, road freight and security — may see that income automatically added to their returns.

Your tax affairs are likely to be straightforward if you're primarily paying tax on salary and wages, with only a small amount of taxable investment income or government payments.

If you're applying for more than basic deductions, or your return includes elements like capital gains, receipt of rental payments and foreign income, your return may not be straightforward.

If you're unsure, you should consult a tax accountant or services such as the ATO's Tax Help or National Tax Clinic for advice.

The ATO is also warning Australians against overclaiming deductions or failing to declare all sources of income.

That includes earnings from side hustles, cash jobs, rental properties and online content creation.

The agency says it uses sophisticated data-matching systems to detect suspicious claims and may delay refunds while returns are investigated.

Taxpayers are also being urged not to simply copy deductions from previous years if their work or circumstances have changed.

The ATO is reminding Australians that the proposed $1,000 standard work-related deduction does not apply this tax time and cannot be claimed until the 2027 tax year.

It is also warning people not to rely on tax advice from artificial intelligence platforms, social media "finfluencers", family or friends without checking official guidance or speaking to a registered tax professional.

body.en:
With millions of Australians receiving a loud siren and text message simultaneously across the country for the national AusAlert test, many had prepared their phones ahead of the warning.

AusAlert is a new national emergency warning system being rolled out by the federal government to deliver faster, more reliable alerts during life-threatening events such as bushfires, floods and cyclones.

Australians experienced the system for the first time during a nationwide test on Monday afternoon, and were told to be aware of the 10-second siren.

For many, it sounded at 2pm AEST, 1.30pm ACST and 12pm AWST, with the alert coming out of mobile phones, smartwatches, and tablets.

It's cell-based technology, so compatible devices connected to a tower sounded the alert.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

AusAlert will be officially rolled out in October as a way for emergency agencies to warn people about life-threatening emergencies.

The alert is designed to ensure warnings are not missed, so it will override "do not disturb" or silent mode settings.

People who didn't want to receive the notification were advised in advance to turn off the device or put it in aeroplane mode.

Authorities also advised people who rely on concealed mobile phones for their safety to switch them off before Monday's test.

If your device was switched on and not in aeroplane mode and it still didn't come through, there may be a few reasons why.

It could be because it wasn't connected to a tower in those 10 seconds, it's not a compatible device or an older phone, or hasn't had system updates.

Authorities have a fairly simple reply: don't panic, it's just a test — but any glitches could give them some tips on how to manage an actual national emergency.

If you didn't get the warning test, you don't have to do anything, or alert any authorities. But if you want to give feedback on how your device responded to the activation, there will be an online survey you can fill out to explain what happened.

"We've obviously got a website, AusAlert, so people can go and provide direct feedback to that if they don't receive the alert or they do and they want to provide some advice about how their phone worked," Emergency Management Minister Kirsty McBain said.

The National Emergency Management Agency, which is looking after the test, said people may experience the test differently depending on where they're located, what kind of device they have or their settings.

"Some people may receive the alert immediately, some may receive it later, and some may not receive it at all," it said.

title.en: 2026 Census: Who must complete it and is it compulsory?

summary.en: The Census reaches beyond Australian citizens — and some people may be surprised to learn they must take part.

body.en:
The Census is run by the Australian government every five years — but Peter Doukas, chair of the Federation of Ethnic Communities' Councils of Australia (FECCA), believes it's important to remember this questionnaire is strictly "apolitical".

Since 1911, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) has conducted the Census of Population and Housing , regardless of the political party in power. Data collected is used to inform decisions around the funding and location of schools, transport and health care services.

Doukas told SBS News the Census also provides valuable information on the demographic makeup of multicultural communities .

"It's not [about] taking a political side ... it's also not allowing the cynicism of government to get in the way of the important role that the ABS holds in collecting ... accurate demographic data about what makes up Australia," he said.

This year, the Census will be held on Tuesday 11 August. The last Census was on 10 August 2021.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Census must be completed by every person in Australia on Census night. That includes visitors to the country, regardless of how long they have been in Australia or how long they plan to stay.

International visitors staying in hotels, motels, or other holiday accommodation can access paper Census forms. People staying in short-term rental accommodation (like an Airbnb or Stayz) can complete the Census online with internet access.

Migrants, refugees and people on temporary visas (including international students and tourists) must also complete the Census.

Doukas said people are "not giving away private information" that could be "used against them" by participating in the survey.

Confidential information, such as names and addresses, cannot be accessed by police or immigration agents.

Online information about the Census is also available in 26 different languages via the ABS website. However, the questionnaire must be completed in English.

People who speak a language other than English can contact the Translating and Interpreting Service (TIS National) which provides access to interpreters who speak more than 150 languages.

People staying in remote and regional Australia, including fly-in fly-out workers, are expected to complete the Census.

Around 30,000 ABS field staff have been employed to ensure all Australians, including people experiencing homelessness or in hospital, can access the form. Field staff will also gather Census information from people in police custody on 11 August.

title.en: Albanese flags new fuel announcements as petrol prices tipped to spike further
